statements.t: We do not anticipate that we will generate significant revenues until we have raised the funds necessary to conduct a marketing program.

We believe that we will be able to raise enough money through the offering to continue our proposed operations, but we cannot guarantee that once we continue operations we will stay in business after doing so.
So, for these reasons, there is substantial doubt that we will be able to continue as a going concern.
